title: Metasoft Benchmark Failure Record
description: A single failure case. Failure-first reporting: expose failure modes before aggregate scores.

category.description: The failure class, e.g. wrong_backward, false_jump_commit, unsupported_business_claim, temporal_leakage.

case_id.description: The case that triggered the failure.

expected.description: The expected outcome. Type is domain-specific.

actual.description: The observed outcome. Type is domain-specific.

reproduction.description: A command or trace that reproduces the failure, e.g. csfb replay --case <id> --trace.

metric_impact.description: Which metric(s) this failure contributes to.
